description: This file defines a Kotlin class implementing a synchronization manager using Android's WorkManager, providing functionality to check ongoing sync status and request new sync operations.

classes.name: WorkManagerSyncManager
classes.description: A synchronization manager that uses WorkManager to handle background sync tasks, providing a flow to monitor sync status and method to initiate sync.

methods.name: isSyncing
methods.description: A Kotlin Flow<Boolean> indicating if a sync operation is currently ongoing.

methods.name: requestSync
methods.description: Method to enqueue a sync work request to the WorkManager, ensuring only one sync worker runs at a time.
